target.statement: Out-of-fold weighted MSE of dense CRTB on clean liver toxicity data (5-fold CV), reported as 0.037
target.dataset: Liver toxicity data (Bushel et al. 2007), available via mixOmics R package

compute.basis: No code is released (only a promise of future release 0.5 of the twoblock package), so the full CRTB algorithm (IRLS loop, SPADIMO cellwise diagnostics, dual-reference weighting, sparse soft-thresholding) must be reimplemented from the paper text; the dataset is small (64x100 and 64x10) and CPU-only, but implementation and debugging of the complex algorithm plus 5-fold CV grid search dominate the time.

blockers: No code released; must implement CRTB from scratch based on paper description
SPADIMO cellwise contribution method is referenced but not fully specified in the paper
Hyperparameter grid for CV is not fully specified (only sparsity values 0.3,0.5,0.7 mentioned for simulation, not for this example)
title: Cellwise Robust Twoblock Dimension Reduction
